articles.title: The Millrace Youth Center Announces New Hours for Fall
articles.deck: The money will be spent over the next year, with the first work starting in January.
body: The Mill Hill Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library. Public works estimates the work will take about 37 weeks once it begins.

articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Weatherby for the many years of service to Stonebridge.
body: Born in Stonebridge in the years after the war, Angela Weatherby spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Stonebridge.
Angela Weatherby died in September at home on Nash Drive, at the age of 74.
